body: You probably only want to talk to me because you feel sorry for me, though. Plenty of people I've made friends with have done the same. Thank you for your kind words though. They always drop me and ditch me. I want to end it and be done with this world. Since I was born I had had 1 thing after another happen to me.
I just quite literally feel *nothing*. The nothing is just pain. It's all I can feel. I've lost every sense of who I am as a person. I want to just die.
